description: The trading-session structure for one exchange, in exchange-local decimal hours (9.5 = 09:30). A four-number "main" means a lunch break (e.g. Tokyo 9–11.5, 12.5–15.5). From 2026-12-06 21:00 ET, nasdaq and nyse also list overnight [21, 4]; pass `at` to read the schedule at a moment. That band is structural — Friday night, the 20:00–21:00 pause, and holiday mornings are answered by is_market_open, not by the array. On nyse the overnight band is NYSE Arca, not Tape A.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp to evaluate AT a specific moment (e.g. "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z"). Defaults to now. Use it for "will the NYSE be open at 3pm ET on Monday?".

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

name: get_trading_sessions
